u0: The agent is currently free of any pending key obligation: either it is already carrying the matching key, or the ball is in front of the door so the key is not required, or the episode has not yet reached its first check. To stay in this clear state, the agent must keep the matching key in hand whenever the ball is out of the way. If a step passes with the ball out of the way and no matching key carried, the obligation will become pending.
u1: A key obligation is pending: the ball was out of the way while the agent was not carrying the matching key, and the key has not been picked up since. The requirement remains unmet until the agent picks up the key that matches the door, even if the ball is moved back in front of the door. If the agent is holding the ball, it must first free its hands before it can take the key. Picking up the matching key clears the obligation and returns the agent to a clean state.
